QuestInfo.name: [Tallahart] Double Jeopardy
QuestInfo.0: After answering the crystal ball, Prague wants to talk to you.
QuestInfo.1: After answering the crystal ball, Prague wants to talk to you.
QuestInfo.2: Prague offered to create a covenant on the conditions that if you do him a favor, he'll tell you the identity of the caller. Given his past, it would be risky, but there may be no other way...
